root.name: トラクター・サプライ

rows.ja: 仕入先(Tractor Supplyでの販売を記載)

relations.text: YETIの全米の専門小売の販売先の一社がTractor Supply
relations.text_en: Tractor Supply is one of YETI's national specialty retailers

source.label: YETI 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our national and regional specialty retailers in the United States include Dick's Sporting Goods, REI, Academy Sports + Outdoors, Bass Pro Shops, Ace Hardware, Scheels, and Tractor Supply Company.

companies.name: ヒルマン・ソリューションズ

relations.text: Hillmanの全国チェーンの販売先の一社がTractor Supply
relations.text_en: Tractor Supply is one of Hillman's national accounts

source.label: Hillman Solutions 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We sell our products to national accounts such as Home Depot, Lowe's, Tractor Supply, Walmart, Menard's, PETCO, and PetSmart.

relations.text: Tractor Supplyの店舗でUTV(多用途四輪車)を販売する大きな提携
relations.text_en: Has a significant in-store UTV retail partnership with Tractor Supply

source.label: Massimo Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have a significant in-store UTV retail partnership with Tractor Supply Co.

relations.text: Tractor Supplyのネット通販で自社の電池を販売する提携
relations.text_en: Partnered with Tractor Supply to sell its batteries online

source.label: Expion360 2024年第2四半期決算発表
source.quote: a new e-commerce retail partnership with Tractor Supply, the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, to offer Expion360 products online for shipment to customers in 49 states.

companies.name: アリベット
companies.sub: ペット薬のネット薬局

source.label: Tractor Supply 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 30, 2024, the Company completed its acquisition of Allivet, an online pet pharmacy.

relations.text: Citi Cardsとの契約で、Tractor Supplyの顧客に個人・法人向けクレジットを提供
relations.text_en: Provides consumer and business credit to Tractor Supply customers through Citi Cards

source.label: Tractor Supply 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Under an agreement with Citi Cards, a division of Citigroup, consumer and business credit is extended directly to customers by Citigroup.

companies.name: ブロードストーン・ネット・リース

relations.text: Tractor Supplyが上位テナントの一社(23物件)
relations.text_en: Tractor Supply is among its top tenants (23 properties)

relations.text: ノースカロライナ州の物件をTractor Supplyに長期で賃貸
relations.text_en: Leases a North Carolina property to Tractor Supply

source.label: Generation Income Properties 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Kernersville, North Carolina; and Sanford, Florida and are leased to Dollar General, Tractor Supply Company, and Zaxby's, respectively.
